artworks.title: The Sacrifice of Iphigenia
artworks.description: La Fosse's Aulis — Calchas read the omen that began the war and died at Colophon when Mopsus outprophesied him on the march home.

artworks.title: Calchas prophesying the Trojan War
artworks.description: Tiepolo's Aulis scene — the seer whose gloomy truth Agamemnon hated, undone at last by a younger oracle on the Ionian coast.
